result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): A shows all three plans in full, including their buttons, and makes Plus stand out with a tinted card, a 'Most popular' badge and the only filled button. B's cards are cut off at the bottom of the viewport. B also changes 'free flat repairs' to 'free flat-rate repairs', which is wrong, and its Plus button differs from the dark Basic and Pro buttons only by colour. Both have a clear headline-to-plans order and a polished look, though A's eyebrow text sits right against the top edge. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both pages are polished and render all three plans legibly. B singles out Plus more strongly, with a tinted card, a filled button against outlined buttons for the others, and a badge, and it fits the cards fully in view. A miswords the feature as 'Free flat-rate repairs' instead of free flat repairs, and its cards run off the bottom of the viewport. B's header sits a bit tight against the top edge, but overall B is the stronger page.
